title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten admission-free Lehigh arts, athletics, and nearby recreation hangs, with student or residency restrictions identified where applicable.

cards.title: Compare color across art and science
cards.subtitle: An ongoing LUAG exhibition
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the gallery, choose two works that use color differently, and compare what each reveals about culture or chemistry.
cards.short_summary: An open-ended gallery hang built around the meanings and materials of color.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh University Art Galleries lists COLOR, CULTURE, AND CHEMISTRY as an ongoing current exhibition and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibitions | Lehigh University Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free. Visit during the operating hours of the campus gallery hosting the exhibition.

cards.title: Trade interpretations in the Lower Gallery
cards.subtitle: Zoellner Arts Center permanent-collection display
cards.notes: Walk the current permanent-collection display together, then each select one work to describe without reading its label first.
cards.short_summary: A free, conversation-friendly look at rotating selections from Lehigh’s art collection.
cards.evidence_claim: LUAG identifies its Lower Gallery in Zoellner Arts Center as hosting an ongoing selection from the permanent collection and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibitions | Lehigh University Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; enter while Zoellner Arts Center and the Lower Gallery are open.

cards.entity_name: Impressions of Dissent: The Long History of Activism and Printmaking
cards.title: Trace activism through printmaking
cards.subtitle: LUAG LAB through October 10, 2026
cards.notes: Visit with classmates and look for repeated symbols, slogans, or production methods that connect prints from different movements.
cards.short_summary: A timely group gallery visit focused on printmaking as a tool for dissent.
cards.evidence_claim: LUAG lists Impressions of Dissent in the LUAG LAB from April 7 through October 10, 2026, and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibitions | Lehigh University Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free. The exhibition is scheduled through October 10, 2026; use current gallery hours.

cards.title: Browse small-press ideas together
cards.subtitle: An ongoing installation in the LUAG Reading Room
cards.notes: Meet in the Reading Room, browse the zine library, and share one layout, illustration, or storytelling device that catches your eye.
cards.short_summary: A low-key free hang centered on independent publications and visual storytelling.
cards.evidence_claim: LUAG lists its Little Zine Library as an ongoing exhibition in the LUAG Reading Room and states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibitions | Lehigh University Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: Admission is always free; access depends on the current hours of the LUAG Reading Room.

cards.title: Take a sculpture-spotting walk
cards.subtitle: An ongoing LUAG collection across campus
cards.notes: Choose a short campus route, photograph details from several outdoor sculptures, and compare how each work changes with its setting.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket campus walk that turns LUAG’s outdoor collection into a shared visual scavenger hunt.
cards.evidence_claim: LUAG lists The Outdoor Sculpture Collection as an ongoing exhibition and states that admission to its exhibitions is always free.
cards.source_title: Current Exhibitions | Lehigh University Art Galleries
cards.access_notes: The outdoor collection has free admission; remain on open campus paths and follow posted building or property restrictions.

cards.title: Catch a home soccer match
cards.subtitle: Free-admission games at Ulrich Sports Complex
cards.notes: Check the current home schedule, meet at Ulrich Sports Complex, and watch a regular-season match without buying an admission ticket.
cards.short_summary: A match-day group hang with free general admission under Lehigh’s current ticket policy.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh Athletics Ticket Central explicitly lists Men's Soccer as Free Admission and says all student tickets are free with ID except specified rivalry games.
cards.access_notes: Men's soccer is listed as free admission. Confirm the home schedule and any separately designated special-event rules before going.

cards.title: Watch field hockey with friends
cards.subtitle: Free admission to Lehigh home matches
cards.notes: Pick a home date from the official schedule, arrive before the opening whistle, and settle in together without purchasing admission.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor athletics hang where the published ticket policy removes the admission cost.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh Athletics Ticket Central explicitly lists Field Hockey as Free Admission and states that student tickets are free with ID except identified exceptions.
cards.access_notes: Field hockey is listed as free admission. Check the official schedule and venue notices for the selected home match.

cards.title: Meet up for a volleyball match
cards.subtitle: Free admission to regular home competition
cards.notes: Coordinate a group around a home match, bring your Lehigh ID if you are a student, and enjoy the competition without a ticket purchase.
cards.short_summary: An indoor zero-dollar spectator activity covered by Lehigh’s free-admission listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh Athletics Ticket Central explicitly lists Volleyball as Free Admission and says student tickets are free with ID except specified rivalry contests.
cards.access_notes: Volleyball is listed as free admission. Students should carry Lehigh ID and verify the current home schedule before arrival.

cards.title: Cheer along a cross-country course
cards.subtitle: Free admission to Lehigh home meets
cards.notes: Check the meet location and spectator guidance, then walk the permitted viewing areas together to cheer at more than one course point.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor meet that combines spectating with a walk around designated viewing areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Lehigh Athletics Ticket Central explicitly lists Cross Country as Free Admission and publishes the activity in its no-charge sports list.
cards.access_notes: Cross country is listed as free admission. Follow the official meet schedule, parking guidance, and marked spectator boundaries.

cards.title: Join Bethlehem's guided trail walk
cards.subtitle: A free city program with a September Greenway date
cards.notes: Register for an upcoming walk, meet at the published trailhead, and bring friends for a guided outing led by a community partner.
cards.short_summary: A scheduled, no-fee social walk connecting residents with Bethlehem trails and local guides.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Bethlehem says Trail Tuesdays runs on the first Tuesday from April through October 2026 and is free for all residents; the September 1 walk uses the South Bethlehem Greenway.
cards.access_notes: Free for Bethlehem residents; sign-up and a waiver are required. Participants under 18 must attend with a parent or guardian.

warnings: Trail Tuesdays is restricted to Bethlehem residents and requires registration and a waiver.
Athletics schedules and venue instructions can change; verify the selected home event before traveling.
Gallery access is free but remains subject to current building and gallery hours.
